limitations: This is static official-document classification, not sandbox or Production mutation evidence.

A webhook lifecycle event establishes notification availability only; it does not establish that an API client can invoke the corresponding mutation. Unknown operations require an exact current entity reference or separately approved sandbox evidence. Not-documented means the reviewed official sources do not establish a Void operation; it is not a claim that every future Intuit surface will reject one.
Supported does not mean universally safe: linked transactions, record state, accounting periods, preferences, entitlements, and locale can still reject or make a mutation inappropriate.
No new write path may use this matrix without server-owned permissions, exact realm context, preview, idempotency, budgets, audit, and separately approved sandbox evidence.
